title: Nimitz Conducts Carrier Qualifications with VFA 106
description: Aircrafts launch and recover from the flight deck of Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) during carrier qualifications for Strike Fighter Squadron (VFA) 106 in the Atlantic Ocean, Oct. 29, 2026. Nimitz is underway in the U.S. 2nd Fleet area of operations in support of Commander, Naval Air Force Atlantic training and readiness. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Gilecia Dias)
credit: U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Gilecia Dias
pass_reason: routine carrier qualifications in calm seas; buffer already heavy on carrier ops
